name: mission-control
description: /mission opens a live map of the main agent, its subagents and every tool call, a code map of the files they touch, and a card per subagent that opens to its whole conversation, with buttons to show its transcript in the main view or ask it to stop (/radar opens that tab). Each view scrolls; a crab at the pane's foot acts out what Claude is doing. The band above the prompt sums up the turn and has one live line per running subagent.
